notes.zh: 审阅注：首次接触完成、“通讯已建立”或银河典藏事件后经隐藏事件leviathans.501显示；文本区分是否已见过其他策展人分部。此窗口只有一个确认选项，服务菜单要在之后的外交联络中打开。
notes.en: Review note: shown through hidden leviathans.501 after first contact, 'Communications Established' or a Grand Archive event; the text differs if another Curator order was met before. It has only an acknowledgement; the service menu opens on later diplomatic contacts.

notes.zh: 审阅注：“说点新的”花能量购买一处尚未接触的守护者的位置（生成“宇宙之谜”兴趣点）；其余选项仅对已建立通讯的守护者开放，各给出该守护者的弱点情报。
notes.en: Review note: 'something new' buys the location of a guardian we have not met (a 'Mysteries of the Universe' point of interest); the other options are only offered for guardians already in contact and give intel on each.

notes.zh: 审阅注：需在“无限神机”剧情中获得pantagruel标记（leviathans_events_2.txt:2315）并曾向策展人询问无限神机（:5707）。
notes.en: Review note: requires the 'pantagruel' flag from the Infinity Machine story (leviathans_events_2.txt:2315) and having asked the Curators about the Infinity Machine (:5707).

notes.zh: 审阅注：首次与策展人交战时（leviathans.595，on_entering_battle）信任-100并设置“已攻击”；若正享有研究援助则被取消并显示本窗口。
notes.en: Review note: on first battle with the Curators (leviathans.595) trust -100 and the 'attacked' flag is set; if research aid is active it is removed and this window shows.

scope.zh: 完整：首次接触、服务菜单全部选项与子菜单、攻击与毁灭后果。
scope.en: Complete: first contact, every menu service and submenu, attack and destruction consequences.
